div.head: VI Atr 14
div.ab: K. ⁊ sy ælc cyricgrið binnan wagum ⁊ cyninges handgrið efen unwemme.
⁊ sy ælc cyricgrið binnan wagum ⁊ cyninges handgrið efen unwemme.
And sy ælc cyricgrið binnan wagum and cyninges handgrið efenunwemme.
Und jeder Kirchenfriede innerhalb der Mauern und des Königs Handfriede bestehe gleich unverletzlich.
And let every church's protection within its walls and the king's personally given protection be equally inviolable.
And every right of sanctuary within the walls of a church, and the protection granted by the king in person shall remain equally inviolate.
And all sanctuary within church walls and the sanctuary received from the hand of a Christian king are to remain equally inviolable.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
VIII Atr 1.1; VIII Atr 3; I Cn 2.2
14 is missing from the Latin paraphrase and the source, so perhaps interpolated by K (Liebermann).

note.seg: 14 fehlt der Lateinischen Paraphrase und der Quelle, also vielleicht von K interpolirt.
14 is missing from the Latin Paraphrase and from the source, and was therefore perhaps interpolated by K.
Da der Satz in V Atr und Paraphrase fehlt, ist er vermutlich nicht authentisch, sondern später hier eingeführt; doch wird er von I Cn 2, 2 = Grið 2 benutzt
Since the sentence is missing in V Atr and in the Paraphrase, it is presumably not authentic but was introduced here later; it is, however, used by I Cn 2, 2 = Grið 2
This clause is not found in V Atr., cf. E. and G. 1; I Cn. 2, 2; Be Griðe, 2.
